baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked verbs شَاءَ and ذَكَرَهُ, with the object retained by the pronoun.
baseline_models.mechanism: A will directed toward an object initiates the act of bringing that object back into present awareness; remembering is active re-presencing rather than accidental recollection.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the selecting impulse that starts the mechanism.
Bringing something to mind after absence supplies the resulting re-presence and retention.

changed_reading.before: A bare permission: whoever wants may remember it.
changed_reading.after: Whoever directs the will toward it can actively restore it to present awareness and hold it there.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَكَرَهُ can realize the tongue branch of ذ ك ر as well as inward recall.
baseline_models.mechanism: Directed willing moves the referent from unspoken availability into voiced mention, making the clause a permission to articulate or relay it.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing supplies the voluntary release of the utterance.
Mention running on the tongue supplies the outward verbal realization of the object.

changed_reading.before: The clause concerns private remembering only.
changed_reading.after: The clause can also authorize a willing person to voice, name, or relay the referent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَاءَ remains the grammatical anchor, while a distant ش ي ء branch images the self being drawn toward an object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Attraction toward the referent can be carried as an affective underside of willing, and that attraction draws what was absent back into memory.

activation_trace.role: Being inwardly drawn or delighted by a thing supplies an affective pull beneath deliberate willing.
Return to mental presence supplies the effect of that pull on attention and memory.

changed_reading.before: Willing is a detached decision followed by recall.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, willingness includes being drawn toward the referent until it returns to awareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening commission couples resolved rising with warning that awakens caution, strengthening the tongue branch of ذَكَرَهُ into renewed public relay rather than mere private speech.

activation_trace.role: Tongued mention anchors the focus clause as a possible outward act.
Resolved rising toward a task supplies bodily mobilization for carrying the message outward.
Warning that frightens and wakes caution supplies the communicative function of the voiced mention.

structural_cues: 74:1-7 is an imperative commissioning sequence, with bodily rising and warning paired in 74:2.
The unrestricted relative subject in 74:55 can widen uptake beyond the initially commissioned addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mobilization, warning, and the focus tongue branch; I infer that a willing rememberer may reactivate the commissioned warning by voicing it, while private recall remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Whoever wishes may mention it as an isolated utterance.
changed_reading.after: Whoever wishes may take up the warning function and make the reminder publicly active again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hostile reader does not merely forget: he cycles through thought, calculated arrangement, inspection, and a settled verbal position. Remembering therefore becomes recovery of the referent from an actively manufactured counter-frame.

activation_trace.role: Restoring an absent matter to mind anchors the focus act that counters displacement.
The heart's repeated turning over a matter supplies the first stage of deliberate cognitive construction.
Calculated management by estimation supplies the arranging stage of the counter-frame.
Directed sight or insight supplies inspection before the conclusion is announced.
Speech functioning as a belief or position supplies the constructed verdict's stabilized endpoint.

structural_cues: 74:18-25 narrates a temporal sequence from thinking and estimating through looking to a spoken classification.
The repeated condemnation of how he estimated marks the sequence as motivated construction rather than neutral inquiry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the staged construction and the focus recall image; I infer that remembering reverses motivated reframing by restoring what the verdict displaced, while a simpler acknowledgment without cognitive reversal remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Remembering repairs passive absence or ordinary forgetting.
changed_reading.after: Remembering can undo a deliberately engineered verdict and restore the obscured referent to governing awareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single disclosed sign functions like an assay: exposure differentiates recipients, stabilizing certainty and trusted assent in some while agitating doubt in others. Willing remembrance is the participant-side uptake of that differentiating reminder.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that makes a matter present anchors the object whose uptake is being tested.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the differentiating test mechanism.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies one observable product of the assay.
Assent in which the heart finds rest supplies the test's strengthened receptive response.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting response exposed by the same sign.
The explicit reminder branch closes the assay sequence and links its effects back to the focus verb.

structural_cues: 74:31 repeats purpose clauses that enumerate divergent effects of the same disclosed number.
The ayah closes by calling the disclosure a reminder for humanity, joining differentiation to reminder-function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test, divergent effects, and an explicit reminder; I infer that 74:55 names willing uptake within that assay, while the test may alternatively be restricted to the number rather than generalized to every act of remembrance.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is neutral information available for voluntary recall.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is an exposing encounter, and willing remembrance is a response that both reveals and stabilizes the recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human willing genuinely selects remembrance, but repeated divine willing governs divergent trajectories of loss and guidance, and the immediate exception places actual remembrance inside that larger agency rather than making human choice self-sufficient.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing anchors the real human selection stated in the focus clause.
Bringing the object to mind anchors the human act whose realization is being scoped.
Departure from guidance supplies one trajectory placed under divine willing.
Repeated will toward an outcome supplies divine selection across both divergent trajectories.
Gentle direction to the path supplies the positive trajectory governed by divine willing.
Divine will immediately following the focus supplies the enclosing condition for actual remembrance.

structural_cues: 74:56 uses the restrictive construction وما ... إلا أن immediately after the human-willing clause.
74:31 applies repeated divine willing to opposed outcomes, misguidance and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human willing, an immediate exception, and divine willing over opposed paths; I infer nested rather than cancelled agency, while the exact causal relation between the two wills remains materially open.

changed_reading.before: Human willingness is a sufficient switch that independently produces remembrance.
changed_reading.after: Human willingness is a real inner selection whose effective remembrance remains nested within divine willing and direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same willing construction is earlier completed by an explicit advance-or-lag alternative. That parallel gives willing remembrance directional consequence: uptake positions a person within a forward/backward field rather than leaving cognition unchanged.

activation_trace.role: Directed willing anchors the focus choice that receives directional force.
Restoring the object to awareness supplies the act that can reposition the recipient.
The parallel willing construction supplies the grammatical bridge to an explicit directional choice.
Advancing forward and preceding supplies one pole of the positional field.
Being delayed to a later position supplies the opposing pole of the field.

structural_cues: 74:37 and 74:55 share the لمن/فمن شاء construction and address an unrestricted member of the audience.
The infinitival pair in 74:37 makes the consequence of willing explicitly binary and directional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close syntactic parallel and opposed movement branches; I infer that remembrance is the later concrete form of consequential positioning, while the two willing clauses may alternatively remain independent uses of generic choice.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is an optional mental act with no stated movement.
changed_reading.after: Willing remembrance becomes a positional act: taking the reminder up moves one within the surah's advance-or-lag alternative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response to the reminder is mapped as a bodily trajectory: turning the side, drawing away, and fleeing a pursuer. Voluntary remembering becomes the counter-trajectory that stops avoidance and turns attention back toward what is present.

activation_trace.role: Bringing the object back into awareness anchors the return opposed to flight.
The reminder that makes a matter present supplies the encountered object from which the audience turns.
Turning one's side supplies the initial reorientation away from the reminder.
Drawing away and increasing distance supplies the middle phase of avoidance.
Outright escape supplies the completed outward trajectory from reminder to flight.
A pursuing force supplies the pressure under which the flight image becomes acute.

structural_cues: 74:49 asks about turning away from the reminder, and 74:50-51 immediately expands that response into a flight simile.
The reminder is named again at 74:54 before the willing-remembrance clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reminder, a continuous avoidance trajectory, and renewed remembering; I infer that the focus act reverses that trajectory by turning back toward the reminder, while the animal simile may alternatively remain only ridicule of refusal.

changed_reading.before: The clause offers detached permission to recall.
changed_reading.after: The clause asks whether one will stop the enacted flight, turn back, and let the reminder become present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience locates agency in controlling the form of disclosure, desiring individually spread written sheets. The focus relocates agency from demanding a bespoke delivery format to choosing uptake of the reminder already available.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing anchors the alternative location of human agency in the focus clause.
Taking up what reminds supplies the available response contrasted with format demands.
Will or desire supplies the audience's competing exercise of agency.
A written sheet supplies the demanded individualized medium.
A published or unfolded writing supplies the demanded mode of disclosure.

structural_cues: 74:52 distributes the demand to each individual and uses a passive delivery construction.
74:53-55 rejects the demand's posture, identifies the material as a reminder, and then returns to whoever wills.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one desire for personalized sheets and another willing tied to remembrance; I infer a contrast between controlling delivery and accepting uptake, while the scroll demand may alternatively be condemned chiefly as evidentiary arrogance rather than customization.

changed_reading.before: Agency means deciding whether the offered information is persuasive enough.
changed_reading.after: Agency is relocated from dictating one's private proof-format to taking up the shared reminder already given.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing paired predicates place the remembered object inside a two-sided moral horizon: guarding the self against harm and covering the effects of prior wrong. Remembering becomes re-entry into that preventive and restorative relation.

activation_trace.role: Restoring the object to awareness anchors the re-entry effected by remembrance.
Aptness and rightful suitability supply the repeated relational frame for both closing qualities.
Placing the self within protection supplies the preventive side of remembered alignment.
Covering a wrong and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the restorative side.

structural_cues: 74:56 repeats أهل around the paired nouns التقوى and المغفرة.
The pair follows immediately after the restriction on actual remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated aptness, self-protection, and protective covering; I infer a before-harm/after-wrong circuit entered through remembrance, while the pair may alternatively name divine qualities without imposing that temporal sequence.

changed_reading.before: Remembering merely restores content to consciousness.
changed_reading.after: Remembering re-enters a relation that can guard before harm and cover the consequences of prior wrong.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus is a finite verb while the cited ذ ك ر branch is a form-distant legal noun. It remains anchored in the focus root and is cross-activated by book, pledged-right, and written-sheet images; downstream prose should call it a documentary resonance of acknowledgment, never replace the lexical sense of ذَكَرَهُ with executing a deed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B008 branch of focus-root ذ ك ر images ذكر الحق as a deed or document of right.

activation_trace.role: A document that records a right supplies the outlier's forensic resonance at the focus root.
Writing that establishes an obligation or judgment supplies an authoritative documentary setting.
A document or pledge held against a right supplies the forensic bond attaching record to accountable self.
Written sheets supply the material record image demanded near the focus.
An unfolded or published writing supplies the record's disclosed form.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is wholly private mental recall.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, remembering carries a documentary undertone: acknowledging the disclosed notice that stands in relation to an accountable, pledged self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because close listening is a form-distant ش ي ء branch and cannot lexically redefine شَاءَ. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains coherence from the surah's warning and struck-sound images; downstream prose should present an acoustic undertone of willing attention, not translate the focus verb as hearing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ش ي ء inventory includes close listening, and ذَكَرَهُ supplies the resulting retention.

activation_trace.role: Inclining the ear and listening closely supplies an exploratory sensory underside to willing.
Retaining and bringing back to mind supplies what attentive hearing deposits.
A warning that awakens caution supplies meaningful content calling for attention.
A sharp struck sound supplies the surah's salient acoustic event and attention trigger.

changed_reading.before: Willing and remembering form a purely abstract mental sequence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, willingness includes inclining the ear so that warning can lodge in memory and return to awareness.

strongest_changes: The focus permission becomes a counter-trajectory to turning away, distancing, and flight from the reminder.
Human willing remains real but is nested inside the divine willing that governs guidance and actual remembrance.
Remembering becomes consequential positioning within the earlier advance-or-lag alternative.
The reminder functions as an assay whose uptake exposes and stabilizes divergent recipient states.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the compact focus clause a convergence point: the same roots of willing and reminding recur in public warning, interpretive testing, opposed movement, embodied avoidance, demands for writing, and the final divine qualification without collapsing those mechanisms into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only baseline cannot identify the pronominal antecedent; 74:54 sharply orients it only after context activation.
The exact causal relation between human willing and divine willing is not fixed by the trace.
Inward recall and outward mention remain coexisting readings rather than a resolved lexical choice.
The documentary and auditory outliers depend on explicitly form-distant branches and should remain qualified resonances.
